headline: Earnings grow year over year despite a sequential pullback
summary_short: Decollte Holdings reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥31.99, up 13.2% y/y from ¥28.27.
summary_long: EPS of ¥31.99 rose 13.2% year-over-year from ¥28.27, but fell 42.3% sequentially from ¥55.42 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
